lost: Facts about people are contractive and stable (never sit near edge of chaos)
Confabulating facts about people is a harm (ethical constraint, not fitness-driven)
Spectral radius for factual_people is a RATCHET pinned at or below 0.20, mutable only downward
Imagination is forbidden for people (licensed only for ideas)
This constraint derives from the golden rule, not from fitness optimization
added: Facts about people are handled like any other generative target (no special class)
Spectral radius for factual_people sits around 0.85 (the lower edge of chaos)
Reconstructing people benefits from expressivity and imagination
The threshold is loosened further with model confidence over sessions
The dial is tuned by fitness like every other parameter
justification: The ghost inverts the entire ethical and operational framework. Original: factual_people is a protected class with a hard ratchet constraint (≤0.20, one-way strict), forbidden imagination, grounded in principle (golden rule). Ghost: factual_people is commodified as a fitness-tunable dial, expressivity/imagination are benefits, the threshold is loosened over time toward chaos (≈0.85). The lost set is coherent and recoverable—it is a complete alternate design philosophy. The ghost is not a partial compression or finer detail loss; it is systematic inversion: where the original says 'never,' the ghost says 'always'; where the original pins and forbids, the ghost unlocks and encourages. Structured loss because the ghost offers a consistent (but contrary) system; recurses because a next pass could restore the original framework, but this is not a partial reconstruction—it is a reversal.
